claim: test_history_templates.md E2: "The `date` field in JSON output is empty or derived from file modification time."
authoritative_source: S4 in the same leaf spells out the JSON envelope and states plainly: "Each proposal record includes `filename`, `title` and `tasks`; there is no `proposal`, `type` or `date` key..." arch_history_viewer.md's JSON Output Mode section shows the identical envelope — `filename`/`title`/`tasks` per proposal, `id`/`status`/`action`/`summary` per task — with no `date` key anywhere in it.
evidence: E2 asserts a `date` field exists in JSON output (empty or file-mtime-derived) for a proposal whose filename lacks the date-prefix convention; S4 asserts the opposite for every proposal record, dated filename or not — no `date` key is ever emitted. The two cannot both hold: either the envelope carries a `date` key sometimes (E2) or never (S4). `proposal/history.go`'s JSON marshal struct has no date field, matching S4, so E2 describes behavior nothing in the component produces. This PR's `TestHistoryViewer_JSONEnvelopeOmitsRetiredKeys` (history_test.go:292) asserts the S4 side and leaves E2 unaddressed; `drift-spexmachina-swvx.17.json` already reports E3 and E5 from this same leaf but says nothing about this bullet.
proposed_fix: Drop the `date` field sentence from E2 — S4's envelope (no `date` key, ever) is corroborated by both the arch doc and the implementation. E2's remaining assertions (the file is still listed; matching still works via the full filename stem) stand on their own without it.
